youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的快遞櫃取件情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從半夜收到取件碼簡訊、查清楚櫃子在哪家分店、發現小小的櫃門塞不下大紙箱、取件碼過期該怎麼辦、請店員幫忙查件、外包破了當場拍照存證、貼上退貨標籤重新寄回，最後回家跟家人報告終於取到了。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Using a Parcel Locker phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue) — a couple gets a pickup code by text at night, works out which branch holds the locker, finds the parcel too big for the small compartment, deals with an expired code, asks the shop clerk to search the system, photographs a torn box on the spot, sticks a new return label on the carton and drops it back in, then reports to the family that the parcel is finally home. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did my phone just buzz?
dialogue.zh: 我的手機剛剛震了一聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me look at that screen.
dialogue.zh: 我來看一下那個螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A message says my parcel arrived.
dialogue.zh: 有訊息說我的包裹到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means it waits in a locker.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz ɪt weɪts ɪn ə ˈlɑkər/
dialogue.zh: 那就表示它在快遞櫃裡等著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It also sent a pickup code.
dialogue.zh: 它還傳來一組取件碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read that code out loud.
dialogue.zh: 把那組碼大聲念出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four, two, nine, one.
dialogue.zh: 四、二、九、一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wrote it on this note.
dialogue.zh: 我寫在這張紙條上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the text show a deadline?
dialogue.zh: 這則訊息上有截止日嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, before midnight on Friday.
dialogue.zh: 有，星期五午夜之前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I enter that number?
dialogue.zh: 我要在哪裡輸入那組數字？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the small touch screen.
dialogue.zh: 在那個小小的觸控螢幕上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this a text or an email?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ə tɛkst ɔr ən ˈimel?/
dialogue.zh: 這是簡訊還是電子郵件？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is a text, see the time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə tɛkst si ðə taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 是簡訊，你看寄出的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sender name looks strange.
dialogue.zh: 寄件者的名字看起來怪怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the tiny link below.
dialogue.zh: 看看下面那個小小的連結。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It only gives a short order number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈoʊnli ɡɪvz ə ʃɔrt ˈɔrdər ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 它只給了一串短短的訂單編號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That number is your proof.
dialogue.zh: 那組數字就是你的憑證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My battery is almost dead.
dialogue.zh: 我手機快沒電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then keep the paper note.
dialogue.zh: 那就把紙條收好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who delivered it, does it say?
dialogue.zh: 有寫是誰送來的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The message names a delivery firm.
dialogue.zh: 訊息上寫了一家快遞公司。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did they leave it at our door?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðeɪ liv ɪt æt aʊər dɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 他們放在我們門口了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you must collect it yourself.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，你得自己去取。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I really hate these pickup codes.
dialogue.zh: 我真的討厭這種取件碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better than no one home.
dialogue.zh: 總比家裡沒人收包裹好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many days can it stay there?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni deɪz kən ɪt steɪ ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 它能在那邊放幾天？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three days, then it returns.
dialogue.zh: 三天，之後它就退回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three days is not much time.
dialogue.zh: 三天並不算多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You work late on Wednesday.
dialogue.zh: 你週三要加班到很晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday suits me much better.
dialogue.zh: 週六對我方便多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday is the last day.
dialogue.zh: 星期五就是最後一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do lockers cost extra money?
dialogue.zh: 用快遞櫃要多付錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The first three days are free.
dialogue.zh: 頭三天是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about after three days?
dialogue.zh: 那三天之後呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two dollars for each extra day.
dialogue.zh: 多一天收兩塊錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two dollars is still fair.
dialogue.zh: 兩塊錢還算公道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plus you must hurry there.
dialogue.zh: 而且你得趕快過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which shop has that locker?
dialogue.zh: 是哪一家店設有那個櫃子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The message does not tell us.
dialogue.zh: 訊息上沒告訴我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we find out tonight.
dialogue.zh: 那我們今晚就查出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with the order page.
dialogue.zh: 先從訂單頁面查起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your hands are faster than mine.
dialogue.zh: 你滑手機比我快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, but I want tea first.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，不過我想先喝茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two cups, then we sit down.
dialogue.zh: 兩杯，然後我們坐下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the mugs, not the chipped one.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə mʌɡz nɑt ðə tʃɪpt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 用馬克杯，別用那個缺角的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six mugs sit on that shelf.
dialogue.zh: 那個架子上放著六個馬克杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fetch them while the water heats.
dialogue.zh: 燒水的時候先去拿下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is your jasmine tea.
dialogue.zh: 這是你的茉莉花茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, now show me the page.
dialogue.zh: 剛好，現在把那頁給我看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says delivered, nothing more.
dialogue.zh: 上面寫已送達，沒有別的說明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scroll up to the address line.
dialogue.zh: 往上滑到地址那一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That address is our old apartment.
dialogue.zh: 那個地址是我們舊公寓的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You forgot to change it, right?
dialogue.zh: 你忘了改地址，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I forgot, how silly of me.
dialogue.zh: 我忘了，我真是太糊塗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fix it after we drink tea.
dialogue.zh: 喝完茶再改過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cabinet color is white, yes?
dialogue.zh: 那個櫃子是白色的，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: White with two wooden shelves.
dialogue.zh: 白色，附兩層木板架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two shelves will fit my books.
dialogue.zh: 兩層剛好放得下我的書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your books need a real home.
dialogue.zh: 你的書需要一個真正的家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you pay with my card?
dialogue.zh: 你用我的卡付的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, mine was closer to hand.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我的卡就在手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the refund comes to you.
dialogue.zh: 那退款就會退到你那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I will buy more paper.
dialogue.zh: 正好，我想再買點紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper for the shelf labels?
dialogue.zh: 寫架子標籤用的紙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sticky white kind, twenty sheets.
dialogue.zh: 那種有黏性的白紙，二十張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty sheets will last all year.
dialogue.zh: 二十張可以用一整年。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save some for the moving boxes.
dialogue.zh: 留一些給搬家用的紙箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We have not opened those yet.
dialogue.zh: 那些紙箱我們到現在還沒打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One room at a time, dear.
dialogue.zh: 一次只整理一個房間，親愛的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dear, you always say that line.
dialogue.zh: 親愛的，你總是這一句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It works, so I keep saying it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɜrks soʊ aɪ kip ˈseɪɪŋ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 因為有用，所以我一直講。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The order page has a store map.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɔrdər peɪdʒ hæz ə stɔr mæp/
dialogue.zh: 訂單頁面裡附了一張店家地圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three red dots shine on it.
dialogue.zh: 上面亮著三個紅點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Zoom in on the middle dot.
dialogue.zh: 把中間那個紅點放大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am trying, wait a second.
dialogue.zh: 我在試了，等一下下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold the phone flat, like this.
dialogue.zh: 把手機拿平，像這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, the letters got bigger.
dialogue.zh: 好了，字變大了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It reads the store on Fifth Street.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ridz ðə stɔr ɑn fɪfθ strit/
dialogue.zh: 上面寫著第五街那家店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That place has a locker wall.
dialogue.zh: 那家店有一整面取件櫃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A wall of doors? That is nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wɔl əv dɔrz ðæt ɪz naɪs/
dialogue.zh: 一整排的門？那太好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save the picture, then check hours.
dialogue.zh: 先把圖片存下來，再查營業時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hours say open till eleven.
dialogue.zh: 營業時間寫著開到十一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow then, after my meeting.
dialogue.zh: 那就明天，我開完會以後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time does your meeting end?
dialogue.zh: 你的會議幾點結束？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four, so we go at five.
dialogue.zh: 四點，所以我們五點出發。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five is dark and cold.
dialogue.zh: 五點外面又黑又冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wear the long coat, then.
dialogue.zh: 那就穿那件長外套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the boots with warm socks.
dialogue.zh: 還有靴子配厚襪子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will lay them on the chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl leɪ ðɛm ɑn ðə tʃɛr/
dialogue.zh: 我會把它們攤放在椅子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are the best planner.
dialogue.zh: 你真是最會安排的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Someone must plan this week.
dialogue.zh: 這一個星期總得有人安排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set two alarms for tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 設兩個明天的鬧鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One is enough, you heavy sleeper.
dialogue.zh: 一個就夠了，你睡那麼沉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two alarms, or I will miss it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu əˈlɑrmz ɔr aɪ wɪl mɪs ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 兩個鬧鐘，不然我會睡過頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, I will shake you myself.
dialogue.zh: 好啦，我會親自搖醒你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the note beside the keys.
dialogue.zh: 把紙條放在鑰匙旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keys, note, mask, and my bag.
dialogue.zh: 鑰匙、紙條、口罩，還有我的包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn off the hall light, then.
dialogue.zh: 那就把玄關的燈關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, sleep well, parcel man.
dialogue.zh: 關好了，晚安，取件先生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning, the note is still there.
dialogue.zh: 早安，紙條還在那兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Morning, now open the phone software.
dialogue.zh: 早安，現在把手機軟體打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It lists one locker store only.
dialogue.zh: 上面只列了一家設有快遞櫃的店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So Fifth Street is the place.
dialogue.zh: 所以第五街就是那個地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The map gives a door number.
dialogue.zh: 地圖上給了門牌號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it, I cannot see well.
dialogue.zh: 你念，我看不太清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Number sixty-two, green sign.
dialogue.zh: 六十二號，綠色招牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the shop with newspapers.
dialogue.zh: 就是那家賣報紙的商店。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the locker sit inside?
dialogue.zh: 快遞櫃是設在店內嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The photo shows an outside wall.
dialogue.zh: 照片顯示的是外面的牆面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Outside means rain and wind.
dialogue.zh: 設在外面的話就要淋雨風吹。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the awning, so it stays dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər ðə ˈɔnɪŋ soʊ ɪt steɪz draɪ/
dialogue.zh: 在雨棚底下，所以不會濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, my papers hate water.
dialogue.zh: 好，我的紙張最怕水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your phone hates water more.
dialogue.zh: 你的手機比紙更怕水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I get into that gate?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ ɡɛt ˈɪntu ðæt ɡeɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 那個鐵門我要怎麼打開？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The same code opens the gate.
dialogue.zh: 同一組取件碼就能開門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One code for two doors, clever.
dialogue.zh: 一組碼開兩道門，真聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type it and the light turns green.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪp ɪt ænd ðə laɪt tɜrnz ɡrin/
dialogue.zh: 輸入之後燈就會變綠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time does the gate close?
dialogue.zh: 鐵門幾點鎖起來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eleven at night, the page says.
dialogue.zh: 頁面上寫晚上十一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eleven is fine for us.
dialogue.zh: 十一點對我們夠用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave work by five, then.
dialogue.zh: 那就五點前離開公司。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it show the box size?
dialogue.zh: 上面有寫格子的大小嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says medium, one door only.
dialogue.zh: 寫著中號，只有一個門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Medium sounds rather small.
dialogue.zh: 中號聽起來滿小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A cabinet is no small thing.
dialogue.zh: 櫃子可不是什麼小東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How big is medium, in numbers?
dialogue.zh: 中號到底是多大，講數字看看？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The size guide shows the figures.
dialogue.zh: 尺寸說明表上有那些數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty centimeters wide, the guide says.
dialogue.zh: 說明表寫寬四十公分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our cabinet box is sixty wide.
dialogue.zh: 我們那個櫃子的紙箱寬六十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty into forty? That fails.
dialogue.zh: 六十要塞進四十？放不下的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe they used a bigger door.
dialogue.zh: 也許他們改用大一點的門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The note says one door only.
dialogue.zh: 紙條上卻寫只有一個門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Notes are often wrong, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過紙條常常會寫錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I call that store now?
dialogue.zh: 我現在該打電話去那家店嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The page shows a phone number.
dialogue.zh: 頁面上有一支電話號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine, double zero, seven, four.
dialogue.zh: 九、兩個零、七、四。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dial it, I will listen here.
dialogue.zh: 你撥過去，我在這邊聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It rang twice, then a voice.
dialogue.zh: 響了兩聲，然後有人接。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What did that voice say?
dialogue.zh: 那個聲音說了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He said the parcel is there.
dialogue.zh: 他說包裹已經在那家店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, ask about the box size.
dialogue.zh: 好，問一下箱子是多大的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He says a big door exists.
dialogue.zh: 他說有一個大號的門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask him which door number.
dialogue.zh: 問他到底是幾號門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He said three, then clicked.
dialogue.zh: 他說三號，講完就掛了電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write three on your hand.
dialogue.zh: 把三寫在你手背上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hand is not paper.
dialogue.zh: 我的手又不是紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then use the note like me.
dialogue.zh: 那就像我一樣用紙條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything else on that page?
dialogue.zh: 那一頁還有別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A map, a fee, and a rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə mæp ə fi ænd ə rul/
dialogue.zh: 一張地圖、一項費用、一條規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What rule? Read it slow.
dialogue.zh: 什麼規則？慢慢念。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sign with your finger on glass.
dialogue.zh: 要在玻璃上用手指簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I cannot sign on glass.
dialogue.zh: 我對著玻璃簽不出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can, it is just a line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn ɪt ɪz dʒʌst ə laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 你可以的，就只是一筆線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A wobbly line, you mean.
dialogue.zh: 你是說歪歪的一條線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wobbly still counts as a name.
dialogue.zh: 再歪也算簽過名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need my order number too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid maɪ ˈɔrdər ˈnʌmbər tu?/
dialogue.zh: 訂單編號也要帶著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The last four digits are enough.
dialogue.zh: 後面的四碼就夠用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our order number ends with nine one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊər ˈɔrdər ˈnʌmbər ɛndz wɪθ naɪn wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 我們的訂單編號最後兩碼是九一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy to remember, then.
dialogue.zh: 那就很好記。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the shop is closed?
dialogue.zh: 萬一那家店關了呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shop opens at seven.
dialogue.zh: 早上七點就開門了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven is early for me.
dialogue.zh: 七點對我來說太早。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So go after work, as planned.
dialogue.zh: 所以照計畫下班再去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we walk or take the bus?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi wɔk ɔr teɪk ðə bʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 我們是走路還是搭公車？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bus costs two dollars.
dialogue.zh: 搭公車要花兩塊錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Walking is free and warm.
dialogue.zh: 走路免費，還會走暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then walk the short road.
dialogue.zh: 那就走那條近路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The short road passes a bakery.
dialogue.zh: 近路會經過一家麵包店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bread first, parcel after that.
dialogue.zh: 先買麵包，再取包裹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, the code waits for nobody.
dialogue.zh: 不行，取件碼才不等任何人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair, parcel first, then bread.
dialogue.zh: 也對，先取件再買麵包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the software keep my code safe?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈsɔftwɛr kip maɪ koʊd seɪf?/
dialogue.zh: 那個軟體會替我存好取件碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps it for one week.
dialogue.zh: 它會幫你存一星期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One week beats three days.
dialogue.zh: 一星期比三天久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the locker counts three days.
dialogue.zh: 只有快遞櫃是按三天算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the screen can show an old code.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə skrin kən ʃoʊ ən oʊld koʊd/
dialogue.zh: 所以螢幕上可能出現舊的碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, check the date every time.
dialogue.zh: 對，每次都要看日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing on a phone is simple.
dialogue.zh: 手機上的事沒有一樣簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still, it beats a paper map.
dialogue.zh: 不過還是比紙本地圖好用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the paper map anyway?
dialogue.zh: 話說那張紙本地圖在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the phone charger, dear.
dialogue.zh: 在手機充電線下面，親愛的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, folded in half.
dialogue.zh: 找到了，對折著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mark the store with a pencil.
dialogue.zh: 用鉛筆把那家店圈起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pencil, not pen, good call.
dialogue.zh: 用鉛筆不用原子筆，說得對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pen marks stay forever there.
dialogue.zh: 筆跡會永遠留在那張紙上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the code once more, please.
dialogue.zh: 現在請把碼再唸一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four, two, nine, one, door three.
dialogue.zh: 四、二、九、一，三號門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He said three is on the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛd θri ɪz ɑn ðə lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 他說三號在左邊那一格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The picture shows doors in rows.
dialogue.zh: 圖片裡門是一排一排的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rows help me find it fast.
dialogue.zh: 有一排排我就能很快找到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand back, the camera is close.
dialogue.zh: 退後一點，鏡頭離得很近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The camera watches the whole wall.
dialogue.zh: 鏡頭對著整面牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So act calm, do not hide.
dialogue.zh: 所以自然一點，別躲躲藏藏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hide? I am not a thief.
dialogue.zh: 躲？我又不是小偷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thief or not, keep it quick.
dialogue.zh: 不管是不是，動作都要快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are ready, I think.
dialogue.zh: 我想我們算準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say the plan once more to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ðə plæn wʌns mɔr tu mi/
dialogue.zh: 再跟我說一次那個計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifth Street, gate code, door three.
dialogue.zh: 第五街、開門碼、三號門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five o'clock, after your meeting.
dialogue.zh: 五點，你開完會以後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am at the gate, it is cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm æt ðə ɡeɪt ɪt ɪz koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 我已經到鐵門了，好冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type the code, I am watching.
dialogue.zh: 輸入取件碼，我在這邊看著系統。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Its screen woke up, it is blue.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts skrin woʊk ʌp ɪt ɪz blu/
dialogue.zh: 它的螢幕亮了起來，是藍色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue means it wants numbers.
dialogue.zh: 藍色代表它在等數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four, two, nine, one, done.
dialogue.zh: 四、二、九、一，按完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did the light turn green?
dialogue.zh: 燈變綠了沒？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green, and a door clicked open.
dialogue.zh: 變綠了，有一個門喀一聲開開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which door is that?
dialogue.zh: 開的是哪一號門？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve, the small one, second row.
dialogue.zh: 十二號，小的那個，第二排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve is way too small.
dialogue.zh: 十二號實在太小了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is empty inside, nothing.
dialogue.zh: 裡面空空的，什麼都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Empty? Check the top corner.
dialogue.zh: 空的？看看最上面那個角落。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No box, no bag, just dust.
dialogue.zh: 沒有紙箱，沒有袋子，只有灰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The phone still says delivered.
dialogue.zh: 我手機上還是顯示已送達。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Delivered to twelve, it says.
dialogue.zh: 上面寫的是送到十二號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That cannot be right, dear.
dialogue.zh: 那怎麼可能對，親愛的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, a cabinet will not fit here.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ə ˈkæbɪnət wɪl nɑt fɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 你看，櫃子根本塞不進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty wide in forty, no.
dialogue.zh: 寬六十怎麼進得了四十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That door is smaller than my arm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt dɔr ɪz ˈsmɔlər ðæn maɪ ɑrm/
dialogue.zh: 那個門比我的手臂還小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the courier never put it in.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə ˈkəriər ˈnɛvər pʊt ɪt ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 所以快遞根本沒把它塞進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He must have left it somewhere.
dialogue.zh: 他一定把東西放在別處了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask the screen, press the help key.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ðə skrin prɛs ðə hɛlp ki/
dialogue.zh: 問那台機器，把求助鍵按下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A help key sits under the camera.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hɛlp ki sɪts ˈʌndər ðə ˈkæmərə/
dialogue.zh: 求助鍵就在鏡頭下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press it long, not once.
dialogue.zh: 要長按，不要只點一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I pressed it, a tone came out.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ prɛst ɪt ə toʊn keɪm aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 我按了，跑出一聲嘟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did a person answer?
dialogue.zh: 有人接起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A recorded voice, very calm.
dialogue.zh: 是一段錄音，聲音非常平靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What does that voice say?
dialogue.zh: 那段錄音說了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says wait two minutes.
dialogue.zh: 它請我等兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, I will stay on the line.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt aɪ wɪl steɪ ɑn ðə laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 你等，我留在電話這頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My fingers are freezing here.
dialogue.zh: 我手指都凍僵了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rub them, the box is not lost.
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌb ðɛm ðə bɑks ɪz nɑt lɔst/
dialogue.zh: 搓一搓，箱子又不會不見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it shows door three.
dialogue.zh: 現在它顯示三號門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three is the biggest door, right?
dialogue.zh: 三號是最大的那一格，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the tall one on the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə tɔl wʌn ɑn ðə lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 對，最左邊最高那一格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then your box went into three.
dialogue.zh: 那你的箱子應該放在三號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But the code only opened twelve.
dialogue.zh: 可是那組碼只開了十二號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big doors need the clerk.
dialogue.zh: 大門要請店員幫忙開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside, I can see his boots.
dialogue.zh: 店裡面我可以看到他的靴子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Knock, the glass is thin there.
dialogue.zh: 敲一下門吧，那裡的玻璃很薄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I knocked twice, nobody moved.
dialogue.zh: 我敲了兩下，沒有人動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the bell by the door.
dialogue.zh: 試試門邊那個鈴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One bell rang, a sweet sound.
dialogue.zh: 鈴噹響了一聲，很好聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And then? Did anyone come?
dialogue.zh: 然後呢？有人過來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A young man came, then left.
dialogue.zh: 有個年輕小伙走出來，轉身又回去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is rough, wait a bit more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz rʌf weɪt ə bɪt mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 這樣有點誇張，再多等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is past six, they close soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz pæst sɪks ðeɪ kloʊz sun/
dialogue.zh: 已經六點多，他們快關店了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The gate closes at eleven.
dialogue.zh: 鐵門十一點才會上鎖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True, but the clerk goes home.
dialogue.zh: 也是，但店員會下班。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then take a photo of twelve.
dialogue.zh: 那你先幫十二號拍張照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One photo of that empty door.
dialogue.zh: 那扇空門我拍了一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Also the screen with the code.
dialogue.zh: 也要拍顯示取件碼的螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got both, the flash is bright.
dialogue.zh: 兩張都拍了，閃光燈很亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that is your proof now.
dialogue.zh: 很好，那就是你的證據。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those words on screen just changed.
dialogue.zh: 螢幕上的字剛剛變了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Changed to what, tell me.
dialogue.zh: 變成什麼，唸給我聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says held at the depot.
dialogue.zh: 上面寫貨物留在轉運站。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Depot? Where is that place?
dialogue.zh: 轉運站？那個地方在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Across the bridge, near the trains.
dialogue.zh: 在橋那頭，靠近火車的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is two buses from us.
dialogue.zh: 從我們家要換兩班公車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too far for one small cabinet.
dialogue.zh: 為了個小櫃子跑那樣遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call them, ask for redelivery.
dialogue.zh: 打過去，要求重新送一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their line is busy, listen.
dialogue.zh: 他們的線路佔線，你聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try again after your bread.
dialogue.zh: 等你買完麵包再撥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A bakery shut at six thirty.
dialogue.zh: 那家麵包店六點半就關了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then no bread, poor you.
dialogue.zh: 那就沒麵包吃了，可憐的你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I smell coffee in that shop.
dialogue.zh: 我聞到那家店裡的咖啡香。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy one, you sound tired.
dialogue.zh: 買一杯吧，你聽起來累了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This machine takes coins only.
dialogue.zh: 這台機器只收硬幣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You keep coins in your long coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kip kɔɪnz ɪn jʊr lɔŋ koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 你那件長外套裡留著硬幣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four of them, you remember everything.
dialogue.zh: 剛好四枚，你什麼都記得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring the change back home.
dialogue.zh: 把找來的零錢帶回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone is at the door now.
dialogue.zh: 現在有人走出門口了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask him about door three.
dialogue.zh: 問他三號門是怎麼回事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He says the box never came.
dialogue.zh: 他說那個箱子從沒送來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never? But the screen said delivered.
dialogue.zh: 沒送來？可螢幕寫著已送達。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He shrugged and went inside.
dialogue.zh: 他只是聳了肩，又走回裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is not an answer, dear.
dialogue.zh: 那不算回答，親愛的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I typed the code once more.
dialogue.zh: 我又輸入了一次取件碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What happened then?
dialogue.zh: 後來怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It flashed once, then went dark.
dialogue.zh: 它閃了一下，然後變暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep mode, it does that.
dialogue.zh: 那是休息模式，它常這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I tapped it, nothing moved.
dialogue.zh: 我敲了敲螢幕，沒有反應。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait two minutes, then tap again.
dialogue.zh: 等兩分鐘，再去敲一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It woke, and it shows Monday.
dialogue.zh: 它又亮了，上面顯示星期一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Monday for what, the pickup?
dialogue.zh: 星期一幹麼，取件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Monday, new code, new attempt.
dialogue.zh: 星期一，新的碼，再試一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means this door stays shut.
dialogue.zh: 也就是說這門今天開不了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I walk home empty-handed.
dialogue.zh: 所以我空著手走回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the short road, warm up.
dialogue.zh: 走近那條路，讓身體暖起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold wind pushed me twice.
dialogue.zh: 冷風把我推了兩下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I put soup on the stove.
dialogue.zh: 我先把湯坐上爐子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are the best, truly.
dialogue.zh: 你真的是最棒的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I set out two bowls.
dialogue.zh: 我已經擺好兩個碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing on that screen.
dialogue.zh: 那個螢幕上還有一行字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What does it say now?
dialogue.zh: 它現在又說什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says this code expires Monday.
dialogue.zh: 它說這組碼星期一失效。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Expires? But Monday is the pickup.
dialogue.zh: 失效？可是星期一才是取件日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I have no code at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ hæv noʊ koʊd æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 那我等於手上沒有碼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We fix that in the morning.
dialogue.zh: 我們明天早上來處理這事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Monday came, the code is dead.
dialogue.zh: 星期一到了，那組碼已經失效。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The screen said expired, yes?
dialogue.zh: 螢幕上是寫過期了，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It showed one red word.
dialogue.zh: 它只秀出一個紅色的字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Red means no door today.
dialogue.zh: 紅色代表今天開不了門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask the machine to wait?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æsk ðə məˈʃin tu weɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我能請那台機器多等一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Machines do not wait for us.
dialogue.zh: 機器才不會等我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a number on the sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈnʌmbər ɑn ðə saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 牌子上寫了一支電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The service line, is it free?
dialogue.zh: 那條客服專線，要打錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It costs nothing from a phone.
dialogue.zh: 用手機撥過去不花錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dial it before your meeting.
dialogue.zh: 在你開會之前先打。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine rings, then soft music.
dialogue.zh: 響了九聲，然後是輕音樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold music, the worst part.
dialogue.zh: 就是等待音樂，最磨人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five minutes, still nobody.
dialogue.zh: 五分鐘了，還是沒人接。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not hang up yet.
dialogue.zh: 先別把電話掛斷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A woman picked up at last.
dialogue.zh: 最後終於有位女士接了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say the order number slowly.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢地報出訂單編號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She asked for my full name.
dialogue.zh: 她要聽我的全名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it, then your address.
dialogue.zh: 報給她，接著唸地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She typed something, I heard keys.
dialogue.zh: 她打了幾個字，我聽到鍵盤聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keys mean she found the file.
dialogue.zh: 有鍵盤聲代表她找到檔案了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She says my box is at the depot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz maɪ bɑks ɪz æt ðə ˈdipoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 她說我的箱子還留在轉運站。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask when it comes back here.
dialogue.zh: 問它什麼時候回到這附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow, one truck, morning only.
dialogue.zh: 明天，一輛貨車，只有早上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the locker waits till Tuesday.
dialogue.zh: 所以快遞櫃要等到星期二。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She offered to resend a code.
dialogue.zh: 她提議再傳一組碼給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it, ask how long it lasts.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt æsk haʊ lɔŋ ɪt læsts/
dialogue.zh: 收下，順便問可以用幾天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three days, from Tuesday.
dialogue.zh: 三天，從星期二算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then Thursday is your last day.
dialogue.zh: 那星期四就是你的截止日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday works, I am free then.
dialogue.zh: 星期四沒有問題，我到時候有空。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say yes, and thank her now.
dialogue.zh: 答應她，現在就道謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She asked if I want home delivery.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi æskt ɪf aɪ wɑnt hoʊm dɪˈlɪvəri/
dialogue.zh: 她問我要不要改成送到府。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is there a fee for that?
dialogue.zh: 那個要另外收費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six dollars on top of the price.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈdɑlərz ɑn tɑp ʌv ðə praɪs/
dialogue.zh: 在原本的價位上再加六塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For a heavy box, that is fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ə ˈhɛvi bɑks ðæt ɪz fɛr/
dialogue.zh: 那麼重的箱子，這價合理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The box weighs twelve kilos.
dialogue.zh: 那個紙箱重十二公斤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve kilos needs both hands.
dialogue.zh: 十二公斤得用兩手才搬得動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will carry it, do not worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ˈkæri ɪt du nɑt ˈwɜri/
dialogue.zh: 我會把它搬回來，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask her for a small cart.
dialogue.zh: 跟她要一台小推車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A cart? She said yes to that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kɑrt ʃi sɛd jɛs tu ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 推車？她說那一項可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They keep carts in the back.
dialogue.zh: 他們都把推車放在後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She says the clerk will hand it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz ðə klɜrk wɪl hænd ɪt aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 她說店員會直接把箱子交給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big boxes stay at the counter.
dialogue.zh: 大箱子都是留在櫃台那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, this box needs staff hands.
dialogue.zh: 對，這箱子得要人員處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So staff must open door three.
dialogue.zh: 所以非得由人員開三號門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One small problem remains.
dialogue.zh: 還有另一個小問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which problem? Tell me.
dialogue.zh: 哪個問題？你說說看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She wants a fee for the wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɑnts ə fi fɔr ðə weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 她要收一段延遲的保管費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How much for those dead days?
dialogue.zh: 那幾天過期的要多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four dollars, she said, quick.
dialogue.zh: 四塊，她很快地說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four is not bad, pay it.
dialogue.zh: 四塊不算貴，付一付吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or she can drop the fee.
dialogue.zh: 不過她說也可以把那筆刪掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why would she drop it?
dialogue.zh: 她幹麼要幫你刪掉？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Because the fault was not mine.
dialogue.zh: 因為出錯的不是我這邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then ask politely, once.
dialogue.zh: 那就客氣地開口問一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I asked, she said no problem.
dialogue.zh: 我問了，她說沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free? The four dollars are gone?
dialogue.zh: 免錢？那四塊就這樣免掉了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She wrote it off, she was kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi roʊt ɪt ɔf ʃi wʌz kaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 她把那筆銷掉了，她很和氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kind people do exist, then.
dialogue.zh: 看來好心人確實存在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My new code came by text.
dialogue.zh: 新的取件碼用簡訊傳來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it, my pen is ready.
dialogue.zh: 你念，我筆都準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven, one, zero, five.
dialogue.zh: 七、一、零、五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not nine one this time.
dialogue.zh: 這次的結尾不是九一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The message also says bring ID.
dialogue.zh: 訊息上也說要帶身分證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your card lives in the drawer.
dialogue.zh: 你的卡在抽屜裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The top drawer, with the tape.
dialogue.zh: 最上面那個抽屜，有膠帶的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tape? What do you need tape for?
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪp wʌt du ju nid teɪp fɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 膠帶？你要膠帶做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clerk said, maybe for a label.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə klɜrk sɛd ˈmeɪbi fɔr ə ˈleɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 店員說，也許是為了貼退貨標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then take tape and a marker.
dialogue.zh: 那就帶膠帶和麥克筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything else for the trip?
dialogue.zh: 這趟還要帶別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bag, gloves, and your patience.
dialogue.zh: 一個袋子、手套，還有你的耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Patience is my weak spot.
dialogue.zh: 耐心是我最弱的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then go early, before the crowd.
dialogue.zh: 那就早點去，避開人潮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is that new code good?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ ɪz ðæt nu koʊd ɡʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 那組新碼可以用多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says three days again.
dialogue.zh: 上面寫又是三天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three days, and not one more.
dialogue.zh: 三天，一天都不能多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So Thursday, and no excuses.
dialogue.zh: 那就是星期四，沒有藉口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if Thursday goes wrong again?
dialogue.zh: 要是星期四又出錯怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we ask for home delivery.
dialogue.zh: 那就改請他們送到府。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six dollars, but no cold walk.
dialogue.zh: 六塊錢，但不用在冷風裡走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And no tiny door to fight.
dialogue.zh: 也不用再跟小門大戰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The agent saved all my details.
dialogue.zh: 那位客服存下了我的全部資料。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Details? Which ones, exactly?
dialogue.zh: 資料？確切來說是哪些？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone and my old address.
dialogue.zh: 我的電話還有舊地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did she fix the old address?
dialogue.zh: 她有把舊地址改過來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She fixed it, new address now.
dialogue.zh: 她改好了，現在是新地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One problem gone, quietly.
dialogue.zh: 一個問題就這麼悄悄不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No news is the best kind.
dialogue.zh: 沒消息就是最好的消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say that while you smile.
dialogue.zh: 講這句話的時候你還在笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The call ended with thank you.
dialogue.zh: 那通電話在謝謝裡結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are polite when paid.
dialogue.zh: 有薪水拿，他們就有禮貌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I should tip a call center.
dialogue.zh: 我該給客服一點小費才對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You cannot tip a voice.
dialogue.zh: 你沒法給聲音小費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday, five o'clock, door three.
dialogue.zh: 星期四，五點，三號門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With your card and the new note.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð jʊr kɑrd ænd ðə nu noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 帶著你的卡和那張新紙條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This note is pink now.
dialogue.zh: 這張紙條變成粉紅色的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pink so you do not lose it.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪŋk soʊ ju du nɑt luz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 粉紅色的，這樣你就不會弄丟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I kept the old note too.
dialogue.zh: 舊的那張紙條我也留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it, the clerk may ask.
dialogue.zh: 留著，店員說不定會要看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two notes, one dead, one alive.
dialogue.zh: 兩張紙條，一張死的，一張活的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Alive means Thursday at five.
dialogue.zh: 活的那張指的是星期四五點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just in, the bell rang twice.
dialogue.zh: 剛進來，門鈴響了兩下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Are you inside now? Good.
dialogue.zh: 你進到店裡了嗎？太好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two people stand before me.
dialogue.zh: 有兩個人排在我前面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, that line moves fast.
dialogue.zh: 等一下，那條隊動得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A man bought eggs and milk.
dialogue.zh: 一個男人買了雞蛋和牛奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then coffee for someone else.
dialogue.zh: 接著另一個人買咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My turn, I walk to the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ tɜrn aɪ wɔk tu ðə ˈkaʊntər/
dialogue.zh: 輪到我了，我走到櫃台前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show her the pink note first.
dialogue.zh: 先把那張粉紅紙條給她看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A young clerk, with glasses.
dialogue.zh: 一位年輕店員，戴著眼鏡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Young clerks often try hard.
dialogue.zh: 年輕的店員通常很肯幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I asked her to check the system.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æskt hɜr tu tʃɛk ðə ˈsɪstəm/
dialogue.zh: 我請她幫我查一下系統。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did she say yes right away?
dialogue.zh: 她馬上就答應了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She said sure, and typed my number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛd ʃʊr ænd taɪpt maɪ ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 她說當然，然後輸入我的號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your phone number or the order?
dialogue.zh: 是你的電話號碼還是訂單號？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only the last four, as asked.
dialogue.zh: 只有後面那四碼，照他們要的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those four digits always help.
dialogue.zh: 那四碼總是很好用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She frowned at her screen.
dialogue.zh: 她對著自己的螢幕皺眉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A frown is never good news.
dialogue.zh: 皺眉從來就不是好消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She says the box is not here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz ðə bɑks ɪz nɑt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 她說那個箱子不在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not here? But the new code?
dialogue.zh: 不在這裡？那新的取件碼呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She thinks the code came too early.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi θɪŋks ðə koʊd keɪm tu ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 她認為那組碼傳得太早了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too early means no truck came.
dialogue.zh: 太早就代表貨車根本沒來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She called the depot on her phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi kɔld ðə ˈdipoʊ ɑn hɜr foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 她用自己的手機打給轉運站。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice of her, really.
dialogue.zh: 她真的挺熱心的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I stood there and held my note.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ stʊd ðɛr ænd hɛld maɪ noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 我站在那裡，手上捏著紙條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take a breath, she is helping.
dialogue.zh: 先深吸一口氣，她正在幫你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She spoke slow and clear.
dialogue.zh: 她說話又慢又清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow and clear means good news.
dialogue.zh: 又慢又清楚，代表有好消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It sits in the depot back room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɪts ɪn ðə ˈdipoʊ bæk rum/
dialogue.zh: 它擱在轉運站後面的房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask if she can bring it here.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ɪf ʃi kən brɪŋ ɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 問她能不能把箱子帶過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She can, but not today.
dialogue.zh: 她能，但不是今天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then when? Ask her when.
dialogue.zh: 那是什麼時候？問她。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday morning, the last truck.
dialogue.zh: 星期五早上，最後一輛貨車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday! Your code dies Thursday.
dialogue.zh: 星期五！可你的碼星期四就失效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I told her that, she laughed.
dialogue.zh: 我把這件事告訴她，她笑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A kind laugh, I hope.
dialogue.zh: 我希望那是和氣的笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She said codes are easy to fix.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛd koʊdz ɑr ˈizi tu fɪks/
dialogue.zh: 她說取件碼很容易重發。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let her print a new one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt hɜr prɪnt ə nu wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 那就請她列印一張新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her printer made a long white slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr ˈprɪntər meɪd ə lɔŋ waɪt slɪp/
dialogue.zh: 她的列印機吐出一張長長的白單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read the dates on that slip.
dialogue.zh: 念一下那張單上的日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Valid from Friday to Sunday.
dialogue.zh: 從星期五有效到星期日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three days again, lucky you.
dialogue.zh: 又是三天，你真運氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunday morning is my free time.
dialogue.zh: 星期日上午我有空。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then Sunday, and nothing else.
dialogue.zh: 那就定週日，不排別的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She asked to see my card now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi æskt tu si maɪ kɑrd naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 她這時要求看我的卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ID from the drawer, good.
dialogue.zh: 就是抽屜裡那張身分證明，帶對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She matched the name, letter by letter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi mætʃt ðə neɪm ˈlɛtər baɪ ˈlɛtər/
dialogue.zh: 她一個字母一個字母核對名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow people are safe people.
dialogue.zh: 慢的人才是可靠的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She made me sign the paper.
dialogue.zh: 她讓我在紙上簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On paper is easier than glass.
dialogue.zh: 在紙上簽比在玻璃上容易。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My line looked like a snake.
dialogue.zh: 我那筆線看起來像條蛇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Snakes still count as names.
dialogue.zh: 歪成蛇也算簽過名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That slip has a phone number too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt slɪp hæz ə foʊn ˈnʌmbər tu/
dialogue.zh: 那張單子上也有電話號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it with the pink note.
dialogue.zh: 跟那張粉紅紙條收在一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One thing worries me here.
dialogue.zh: 有一件事讓我有點在意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What, the box again?
dialogue.zh: 怎麼了，又是箱子？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She paused, not sure about size.
dialogue.zh: 她頓了一下，對尺寸不太確定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask her to read the label.
dialogue.zh: 請她把箱子上標籤唸一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She read: one box, sixty wide.
dialogue.zh: 她念：一箱，寬六十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty again, that is the width.
dialogue.zh: 又是六十，那是講寬度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She says the big door is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz ðə bɪɡ dɔr ɪz fri/
dialogue.zh: 她說那個大格子是空著的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free means you can collect there.
dialogue.zh: 空著就代表你能在那邊取。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, she keeps it behind the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ʃi kips ɪt bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈkaʊntər/
dialogue.zh: 不，她說要收在櫃台後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Counter is better, fewer doors.
dialogue.zh: 在櫃台比較好，不用開門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But the counter gets busy at noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðə ˈkaʊntər ɡɛts ˈbɪzi æt nun/
dialogue.zh: 不過櫃台一到中午就很忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then be there before noon.
dialogue.zh: 那就中午之前過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunday opens the store at ten.
dialogue.zh: 週日店家十點才開門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten suits me, I rise early.
dialogue.zh: 十點剛好，我起得早。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I thanked her twice, maybe more.
dialogue.zh: 我道了兩次謝，也許更多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: People who help like thanks.
dialogue.zh: 肯幫忙的人喜歡聽見謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She gave me a mint, too.
dialogue.zh: 她也給了我一顆薄荷糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A mint is a small gift.
dialogue.zh: 一顆薄荷糖也算是小禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A line grew behind me.
dialogue.zh: 我身後的隊伍變長了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Step aside, let them pass.
dialogue.zh: 往旁邊讓一下，讓他們過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I stayed to buy two eggs.
dialogue.zh: 我留下來買了兩顆蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy bread too, we have none.
dialogue.zh: 麵包也買一條，我們沒有了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This bread here costs three dollars.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的麵包要三塊錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three for fresh bread, fine.
dialogue.zh: 新鮮麵包三塊，值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I paid for both, in the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ peɪd fɔr boʊθ ɪn ði ɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 到頭來兩樣我都付了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coffee too? In a paper cup?
dialogue.zh: 也買了咖啡嗎？紙杯裝的那種？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, then she asked, cash or card.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðɛn ʃi æskt kæʃ ɔr kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 對，然後她問我要現金還是刷卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Card is faster, use that.
dialogue.zh: 刷卡比較快，就那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It asked me a tip question.
dialogue.zh: 機器問了我一個小費的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press no, the coffee is fine.
dialogue.zh: 按沒有，咖啡好喝就好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I pressed no twice, it asked again.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ prɛst noʊ twaɪs ɪt æskt əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 我按了兩次沒有，它又問一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The screen only wants a yes.
dialogue.zh: 那螢幕只想要你說是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Outside, the wind felt softer.
dialogue.zh: 走到外面，風感覺柔和些了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good news makes the air warm.
dialogue.zh: 有好消息，連空氣都變暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I got a date, and a slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɑt ə deɪt ænd ə slɪp/
dialogue.zh: 我拿到了一個日子和一張單子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is progress, real progress.
dialogue.zh: 那就算是進展，真正的進展。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me you are smiling.
dialogue.zh: 告訴我你在笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am smiling, both corners up.
dialogue.zh: 我在笑，兩邊嘴角都上揚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunday, ten sharp, the counter.
dialogue.zh: 週日，整十點，櫃台。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will wake you at nine.
dialogue.zh: 我九點會叫你起床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine is kind, eight is cruel.
dialogue.zh: 九點算客氣，八點就太狠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine, then. No more talk.
dialogue.zh: 那就九點，不再多講。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last look at that slip.
dialogue.zh: 最後再看一眼那張單子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Code, date, store, all there.
dialogue.zh: 取件碼、日期、店名，全都在上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I fold it in my coat pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ foʊld ɪt ɪn maɪ koʊt ˈpɑkət/
dialogue.zh: 我把它摺起來放進外套口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not lose that one, please.
dialogue.zh: 這一次別再弄丟了，拜託。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten o'clock, the door is open.
dialogue.zh: 十點整，店門開著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are early, that is good.
dialogue.zh: 你挺早，這很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Its glass door stayed locked.
dialogue.zh: 那扇玻璃門還鎖著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Locked at ten? Knock once.
dialogue.zh: 十點還鎖著？敲一下門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A man opened it, smiling.
dialogue.zh: 有個男人開了門，還在笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The owner? Or the morning clerk?
dialogue.zh: 是老闆還是早班的店員？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His boots look very big.
dialogue.zh: 他那雙靴子看起來很大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Boots mean he carries boxes.
dialogue.zh: 穿靴子代表他負責搬箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I showed him my white slip.
dialogue.zh: 我把那張白單拿給他看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did he know the name?
dialogue.zh: 他認得單上的名字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He read it and went to the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi rɛd ɪt ænd wɛnt tu ðə bæk/
dialogue.zh: 他念了一遍就走進後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait by the coffee machine.
dialogue.zh: 你在咖啡機旁邊等就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A coffee machine hissed at me.
dialogue.zh: 一台咖啡機對著我嘶了一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is jealous, do not mind.
dialogue.zh: 它在吃醋，別放在心上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here he comes, with my box.
dialogue.zh: 他回來了，抱著我的箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both arms? Is it heavy?
dialogue.zh: 用兩手抱嗎？很重？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both arms, and one bad knee.
dialogue.zh: 兩手都用到，還有一隻壞膝蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set it down, let him rest.
dialogue.zh: 先放下來，讓那人歇一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He put it on the low table.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi pʊt ɪt ɑn ðə loʊ ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 他把箱子放到那張矮桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now look at it, all sides.
dialogue.zh: 現在把四個面都看一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One corner is crushed flat.
dialogue.zh: 其中一個角被壓得扁扁的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flat how? Torn or only bent?
dialogue.zh: 扁成怎樣？破了還是只有彎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Torn, I see the brown inside.
dialogue.zh: 破了個口，我看到裡層的棕色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brown means the cardboard, yes.
dialogue.zh: 棕色就是紙板本來的顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And a wet mark on the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ə wɛt mɑrk ɑn ðə tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 頂面還有一塊濕濕的痕跡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wet marks come from rain.
dialogue.zh: 濕痕通常是雨水留下的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half the tape is split open.
dialogue.zh: 封箱膠帶裂開了一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Split tape means someone opened it.
dialogue.zh: 膠帶裂開代表有人打開過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or the box fell from a shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr ðə bɑks fɛl frʌm ə ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 也可能是箱子從架子上摔了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same result, ask about it.
dialogue.zh: 結果都一樣，問一下原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He says boxes fall down often.
dialogue.zh: 他說箱子常常會掉下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And he says that to your face?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd hi sɛz ðæt tu jʊr feɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 他當著你的面這樣講？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He looked at his boots, yes.
dialogue.zh: 他低頭看著自己的靴子，是的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Boots are easier than eyes.
dialogue.zh: 看靴子總比看眼睛輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He wants my signature now.
dialogue.zh: 他現在要我在單上簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not sign a clean paper.
dialogue.zh: 別在寫著完好的紙上簽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This paper says received in good order.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈpeɪpər sɛz rɪˈsivd ɪn ɡʊd ˈɔrdər/
dialogue.zh: 單子上寫著貨物完好收訖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cross that line, write damaged.
dialogue.zh: 把那行劃掉，寫上破損。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wrote box torn, wet, crushed.
dialogue.zh: 我寫下：箱破、潮濕、壓扁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then sign under your own words.
dialogue.zh: 然後在你自己寫的字的下面簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In blue ink, my hand shook.
dialogue.zh: 用藍色的筆，我的手在發抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shaking is fine, write the date.
dialogue.zh: 手抖沒關係，把日期寫上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, the camera part.
dialogue.zh: 再來是拍照的環節。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six shots, all four sides.
dialogue.zh: 拍六張，四個面都要拍到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One shot of the crushed corner.
dialogue.zh: 先拍那個被壓扁的角。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the light above the table.
dialogue.zh: 用桌子上頭那盞燈照。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That lamp there is very bright.
dialogue.zh: 那一盞燈非常亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, now the wet mark again.
dialogue.zh: 好，接著再拍那塊濕痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I took two of that spot.
dialogue.zh: 那個痕跡我拍了兩張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Also the split tape, close up.
dialogue.zh: 也要靠近拍裂開的膠帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the label with my name.
dialogue.zh: 還有貼著我名字的那張標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Especially the small printed numbers.
dialogue.zh: 特別是那串小小的編號數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Barcode as well, he said.
dialogue.zh: 他說連條碼那邊也要拍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Without that they cannot claim.
dialogue.zh: 少了那個他們沒辦法受理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I shot nine pictures in all.
dialogue.zh: 我總共拍了九張照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send them to me right now.
dialogue.zh: 現在立刻傳給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sent, did they reach you?
dialogue.zh: 傳出去了，你有收到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four came, wait for the rest.
dialogue.zh: 到了四張，等其他那幾張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My signal here is awful.
dialogue.zh: 我在這裡的訊號糟透了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand by the window then.
dialogue.zh: 那你就站到窗戶旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the window, all nine sent.
dialogue.zh: 站在窗邊，九張全都傳完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, keep them in your phone.
dialogue.zh: 很好，原檔留著在你手機裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He read my written note twice.
dialogue.zh: 他把我寫的註記看了兩遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice means he believes you.
dialogue.zh: 看兩遍代表他相信你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He called his boss, short talk.
dialogue.zh: 他打電話給主管，講得很短。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What did the boss say?
dialogue.zh: 那位主管怎麼說？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open the box, check the parts.
dialogue.zh: 他說打開箱子，檢查裡面的零件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do it on the table, slowly.
dialogue.zh: 就在桌子上慢慢打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside, two white side panels.
dialogue.zh: 裡面是兩塊白色的側板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any crack on those panels?
dialogue.zh: 那兩塊板子上有裂縫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One door shows a long scratch.
dialogue.zh: 其中一扇門上有一道長刮痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deep scratch? Or only paint?
dialogue.zh: 刮得深嗎？還是只傷到漆？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deep enough to catch my nail.
dialogue.zh: 深到可以卡住我的指甲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one cannot be hidden.
dialogue.zh: 那種痕跡是藏不住的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even the screw bag tore open.
dialogue.zh: 連裝螺絲的塑膠袋都破了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How many screws are left?
dialogue.zh: 裡頭還剩下幾顆螺絲？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve, and the guide says fourteen.
dialogue.zh: 十二顆，說明書上寫十四顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two missing, that is bad.
dialogue.zh: 少了兩顆，這就不妙了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We cannot build this here.
dialogue.zh: 我們在這家店裡沒辦法組裝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, so what is the choice?
dialogue.zh: 對啊，那現在有幾種選擇？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He gave me two ways out.
dialogue.zh: 他給了我兩條路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me both, slow and clear.
dialogue.zh: 兩條都跟我說，慢一點講清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep it, and get money back.
dialogue.zh: 留下櫃子，退一部分錢回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How much back, did he say?
dialogue.zh: 他說會退多少回來？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One fifth of the price only.
dialogue.zh: 只退原價的五分之一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For a scratched door? No thanks.
dialogue.zh: 為了那道刮痕？那算了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Other choice is a return.
dialogue.zh: 另外一條路就是退貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full money back, that one.
dialogue.zh: 全額退款，那就選這條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I said return, and he nodded.
dialogue.zh: 我說要退，他點了點頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask him for the label now.
dialogue.zh: 現在就跟他要退貨標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He prints, it takes one minute.
dialogue.zh: 他正在列印，說要一分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: While you wait, one more photo.
dialogue.zh: 等的時候再補拍一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of what, the box or the table?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv wʌt ðə bɑks ɔr ðə ˈteɪbəl?/
dialogue.zh: 拍什麼，箱子還是桌子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The whole box, one wide shot.
dialogue.zh: 整個箱子，拍一張範圍大點的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, and the clerk smiled.
dialogue.zh: 拍好了，那位店員笑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He likes a careful man.
dialogue.zh: 他喜歡做事細心的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He said claims take two days.
dialogue.zh: 他說審核申請要兩個工作日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two days, then we know all.
dialogue.zh: 兩天之後我們就全清楚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This box must go back today.
dialogue.zh: 這箱子今天就得退回去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can you carry it up the stairs?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju ˈkæri ɪt ʌp ðə stɛrz?/
dialogue.zh: 你搬得動那段樓梯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not yet, it waits by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt ɪt weɪts baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 還沒搬上去，它就在門口擱著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not block the front door.
dialogue.zh: 別把它放在門口擋路就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It leans on the coat rack.
dialogue.zh: 它斜靠著衣帽架。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rack has two hooks left.
dialogue.zh: 架子上頭還剩兩個鉤子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is the label, sticky side.
dialogue.zh: 這就是退貨標籤，有黏的那一面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Peel it slow, do not tear it.
dialogue.phonetic: /pil ɪt sloʊ du nɑt tɪr ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢地撕下來，別把它撕破。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does this one go?
dialogue.zh: 這張標籤要貼在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On top, flat, away from edges.
dialogue.zh: 貼在最上面，要平，離邊緣遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I cover the old label?
dialogue.zh: 舊的那張運單要蓋掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, old bars confuse the scanner.
dialogue.zh: 要蓋，舊條碼會讓掃描器搞錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will cover it with brown tape.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ˈkʌvər ɪt wɪð braʊn teɪp/
dialogue.zh: 我用棕色膠帶把它蓋起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brown tape is ugly but right.
dialogue.zh: 棕色膠帶難看，不過做法對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I tape over the new bars?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ teɪp ˈoʊvər ðə nu bɑrz?/
dialogue.zh: 那我可以在新條碼上貼膠帶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shiny tape hides the code.
dialogue.zh: 亮面的膠帶會讓條碼掃不出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So paper tape, on the corners.
dialogue.zh: 那就用紙膠帶，只貼四個角。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, press the middle flat.
dialogue.zh: 就對了，中間也要壓平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those screws need a new bag.
dialogue.zh: 那些螺絲得換個袋子裝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the jar lid, tape it shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə dʒɑr lɪd teɪp ɪt ʃʌt/
dialogue.zh: 用那個罐子的蓋子，再用膠帶封口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two panels, folded paper inside.
dialogue.zh: 兩塊側板，裡面塞的是摺過的紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wrap the scratched door first.
dialogue.zh: 先把有刮痕的那扇門包起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper? We have none now.
dialogue.zh: 紙？我們手上現在沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The newspaper, then, one page.
dialogue.zh: 那就用報紙，撕一頁下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rolled it, tied with string.
dialogue.zh: 把它捲起來，再用繩子綁住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, no sharp edge loose.
dialogue.zh: 好，尖角就不會露在外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Its top flap will not stay down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts tɑp flæp wɪl nɑt steɪ daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 那片箱蓋壓不下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The crushed part shrinks the box.
dialogue.zh: 被壓壞的那塊讓箱子縮小了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I sat on it, then it closed.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sæt ɑn ɪt ðɛn ɪt kloʊzd/
dialogue.zh: 我整個人坐上去，它就闔起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your weight works like a press.
dialogue.zh: 你的體重就像一台夾具。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Taped once, twice, then a cross.
dialogue.zh: 先貼一道，再一道，最後十字封。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A cross is good, boxes like it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə krɔs ɪz ɡʊd ˈbɑksəz laɪk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 十字封法最好，箱子喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guess how heavy it is now.
dialogue.zh: 猜猜它現在到底有多重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve kilos, plus the tape.
dialogue.zh: 十二公斤，再加那些膠帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This slip shows a weight limit.
dialogue.zh: 這張單子上寫了重量上限。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How much? Read that line.
dialogue.zh: 多少？念那一行給我聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty kilos for the big slot.
dialogue.zh: 大投件口限重二十公斤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are under, go ahead.
dialogue.zh: 你在限制以下，可以直接過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or the counter takes anything.
dialogue.zh: 不然櫃台那種什麼都收。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Counter is faster, but try the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkaʊntər ɪz ˈfæstər bʌt traɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 櫃台比較快，不過你試試那個門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our gate code still works.
dialogue.zh: 開鐵門的那組碼還能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, it is still Sunday.
dialogue.zh: 當然能用，現在還是星期日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That red slot is on the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt rɛd slɑt ɪz ɑn ðə lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 紅色的退貨口在最左邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Red for returns, smart colors.
dialogue.zh: 紅色代表退貨，顏色用得聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It asked what I want to do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt æskt wʌt aɪ wɑnt tu du/
dialogue.zh: 螢幕問說我現在要做什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press return, the second word.
dialogue.zh: 按退貨，就是第二個選項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then it wants the barcode scan.
dialogue.zh: 然後它要掃那個條碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold it flat above the glass.
dialogue.zh: 把標籤平平地舉在玻璃上方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It beeped, a door woke up.
dialogue.zh: 它嗶了一聲，有個門醒了過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which door, the big bottom one?
dialogue.zh: 是哪一扇？最下面那個大的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Number five, the lowest one.
dialogue.zh: 五號，就是最低的那一格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift with your knees, not back.
dialogue.zh: 用膝蓋舉，不要用到腰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In it went, with one push.
dialogue.zh: 輕輕一推，整個箱子就進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close it slow, listen for click.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢關上，注意聽喀那一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I pushed until it clicked.
dialogue.zh: 我一直推，直到聽見喀一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the screen asks one thing.
dialogue.zh: 接下來螢幕會再問你一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It asked if the door was shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt æskt ɪf ðə dɔr wʌz ʃʌt/
dialogue.zh: 它問門到底關起來了沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say yes only if you saw it.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ jɛs ˈoʊnli ɪf ju sɔ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你親眼看到關上，才按是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saw the light turn red.
dialogue.zh: 我看見那盞小燈變紅了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Red means it is locked now.
dialogue.zh: 紅色就代表現在已經鎖上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A small receipt came out then.
dialogue.zh: 接著吐出一張小小的收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep that, it is your proof.
dialogue.zh: 那張收起來，這是你的憑證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It has a tracking number.
dialogue.zh: 上面還有一組追蹤號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it, I have my pencil.
dialogue.zh: 唸給我聽，我手上有鉛筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven, six, two, then a letter.
dialogue.zh: 七、六、二，然後是一個字母。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which letter? B or P?
dialogue.zh: 哪個字母？是 B 還是 P？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A big R, they told me.
dialogue.zh: 他們說是大大的一個 R。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: R means return, of course.
dialogue.zh: R 就是退貨，這還用說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Its screen wished me a good day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts skrin wɪʃt mi ə ɡʊd deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 螢幕最後還祝我一天愉快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A polite machine, finally.
dialogue.zh: 總算遇到一台有禮貌的機器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are sticky from tape.
dialogue.zh: 我的兩手都是膠帶留下的黏痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wash them warm, no scrubbing.
dialogue.zh: 用溫水洗，別在那裡猛搓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slowly the glue came off with oil.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsloʊli ðə ɡlu keɪm ɔf wɪð ɔɪl/
dialogue.zh: 抹了一點油，膠就慢慢下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cooking oil, the best trick.
dialogue.zh: 廚房那瓶油，是最妙的一招。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Receipt in the drawer with ID.
dialogue.zh: 收據放進抽屜，跟身分證擺在一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same drawer, same careful man.
dialogue.zh: 同樣那個抽屜，同樣那個細心的男人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the refund clock starts.
dialogue.zh: 從這一刻起，退款開始計時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How long did the paper say?
dialogue.zh: 那張單子上寫要多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five to seven working days.
dialogue.zh: 五到七個工作日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is next week, then.
dialogue.zh: 那就是下個星期的事了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back to your card, they said.
dialogue.zh: 他們說錢會退到你那張卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My card, so I will watch it.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kɑrd soʊ aɪ wɪl wɑtʃ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 卡是我的，我會盯著那個數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At least five days of waiting.
dialogue.zh: 起碼還要等上五天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Money sleeps, but we do not.
dialogue.zh: 錢在睡覺，我們不用跟著睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing in my pocket.
dialogue.zh: 我口袋裡還有一樣東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pink note? Still there?
dialogue.zh: 那張粉紅紙條？居然還在？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wrote one more code on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ roʊt wʌn mɔr koʊd ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我在上面又寫了一組新碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New code? For what box?
dialogue.zh: 新的碼？是給哪個箱子的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For the free one, they said.
dialogue.zh: 他們說那是免費重送的那一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A replacement! When does it come?
dialogue.zh: 是補貨！什麼時候會送來？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tuesday, the note says noon.
dialogue.zh: 星期二，紙條上寫中午。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuesday, I will stay home.
dialogue.zh: 星期二我待在家，等你回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same gate and same door again?
dialogue.zh: 一樣是那個鐵門、同一個格子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three, they wrote it clearly.
dialogue.zh: 三號，他們把那數字寫得清清楚楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve scared me for life.
dialogue.zh: 十二號那格把我嚇一輩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve is closed for big boxes.
dialogue.zh: 十二號以後不收大箱子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also the clerk knows my face.
dialogue.zh: 而且那位店員已經認得我的臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Faces beat a paper slip.
dialogue.zh: 一張臉比一張紙單還管用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two days, then my cabinet.
dialogue.zh: 再兩天，我的櫃子就會到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With fourteen screws this time.
dialogue.zh: 這一次會附完整的十四顆螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will build it that same night.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl bɪld ɪt ðæt seɪm naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那天晚上我就把它組裝起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save the extra screws for me.
dialogue.zh: 多出來的螺絲記得留幾顆給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tuesday noon, I am at the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuzˌdeɪ nun aɪ æm æt ðə ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 星期二中午，我已經站在鐵門前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same gate, same code, deep breath.
dialogue.zh: 同樣的鐵門、同樣的碼，深呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The light went green at once.
dialogue.zh: 燈立刻就變綠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No red word this time?
dialogue.zh: 這次沒有紅色的字了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: None, the screen said thank you.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，螢幕還跟我說謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green never looked so good.
dialogue.zh: 綠燈從來沒這麼好看過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Door three stood wide open.
dialogue.zh: 三號門大開著等我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the box was waiting inside?
dialogue.zh: 那個箱子就在裡面等我是嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sitting there, tall and clean.
dialogue.zh: 它直立在那裡，又高又乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No wet mark, no crushed corner?
dialogue.zh: 沒有濕痕，也沒有壓扁的角？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect tape, four straight lines.
dialogue.zh: 封箱膠帶貼得整整齊齊，四條直線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Who tapes a box so neat?
dialogue.zh: 誰會把箱子貼得這麼整齊？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clerk winked at me, once.
dialogue.zh: 那位店員對我眨了一下眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A wink means we did it right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wɪŋk minz wi dɪd ɪt raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 眨一下眼，代表我們做對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clerk said no more fees.
dialogue.zh: 她說這一次半文不收。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free is my favorite word.
dialogue.zh: 免費是我最喜歡的詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I brought it home, two trips.
dialogue.zh: 我把它搬回家，跑了兩趟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two trips for one cabinet.
dialogue.zh: 為了個小櫃子跑兩趟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The stairs were my enemy.
dialogue.zh: 那段樓梯完全是我的敵人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Knees again, the same two?
dialogue.zh: 又是膝蓋？還是原來那兩條？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It waits by the bedroom door.
dialogue.zh: 它就立在臥室門口旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not on the rack this time.
dialogue.zh: 這一次別再靠著衣帽架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open it, the knife is here.
dialogue.zh: 我來拆箱，刀就在這兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cut the tape, do not slice deep.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌt ðə teɪp du nɑt slaɪs dip/
dialogue.zh: 切膠帶就好，別往深了割。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Screws in a sealed little jar.
dialogue.zh: 螺絲裝在一個封好的小罐子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fourteen, I hope, count them.
dialogue.zh: 希望是十四顆，你數一數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fourteen, and two spares.
dialogue.zh: 十四顆，外加兩顆備用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spares are a gift, keep them.
dialogue.zh: 備品就算是贈品，收起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The guide has pictures, no words.
dialogue.zh: 說明書裡全都是圖，一個字也沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pictures beat a long text.
dialogue.zh: 圖比一大段文字好懂多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six steps, and one wooden peg.
dialogue.zh: 六個步驟，還有一根木栓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use your shoe, not my book.
dialogue.zh: 敲打時用你的鞋，別用我的書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The shelves slid right in.
dialogue.zh: 兩層板輕輕一推就到位了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right in, with no forcing.
dialogue.zh: 一推就進，完全不用硬擠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It leans left, just a little.
dialogue.zh: 它往左邊歪，只有一點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fold the card under one foot.
dialogue.zh: 把紙板摺起來墊在一隻腳下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it sits flat and firm.
dialogue.zh: 現在它又平又穩地立著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Firm is what a shelf must be.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrm ɪz wʌt ə ʃɛlf məst bi/
dialogue.zh: 穩，才是一個架子該有的樣子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Level on both edges, yes.
dialogue.zh: 兩個邊都是水平的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Level and white, like new.
dialogue.zh: 又平又白，跟新的一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do the books go now?
dialogue.zh: 那些書現在要擺到哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tall ones low, small ones high.
dialogue.zh: 高的放下一層，小的放上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve hard covers, eight soft.
dialogue.zh: 十二本硬皮的，八本軟皮的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft ones on the top shelf.
dialogue.zh: 軟皮的放最上面那一層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The plant wants a spot too.
dialogue.zh: 那盆植物也想佔個位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No plant, water kills the wood.
dialogue.zh: 不能放植物，水會讓木板壞掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your call, the wood looks thin.
dialogue.zh: 你決定吧，木頭看起來薄薄的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thin but strong, like us.
dialogue.zh: 薄但是堅強，就跟我們一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like us, holding many things.
dialogue.zh: 像我們一樣撐著一大堆事情。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now you make poetry at night.
dialogue.zh: 你現在半夜開始作詩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your mother is on the phone.
dialogue.zh: 你媽媽來電話了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put her on, I will tell all.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt hɜr ɑn aɪ wɪl tɛl ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 讓她接，我從頭說給她聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here she is, the phone is warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ʃi ɪz ðə foʊn ɪz wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 她接了，手機都是溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mom, we got the cabinet today.
dialogue.zh: 媽，我們今天終於把櫃子取回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She asks what took so long.
dialogue.zh: 她問說到底什麼拖這麼久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A wrong door, and a dead code.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə rɔŋ dɔr ænd ə dɛd koʊd/
dialogue.zh: 一扇開錯的門，還有一組過期的碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She laughed at the dead code.
dialogue.zh: 她一聽到碼過期就笑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She had one last month, too.
dialogue.zh: 她說她上個月也遇到一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, she used a locker?
dialogue.zh: 等等，她也用過快遞櫃？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice, and never told us.
dialogue.zh: 用過兩次，卻從來沒告訴我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask her which store, which day.
dialogue.zh: 問她是哪一家店、哪一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The same store, Fifth Street, yes.
dialogue.zh: 就是同一間店，第五街，沒錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She knows the clerk with glasses?
dialogue.zh: 她也認識那位戴眼鏡的店員？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She says that clerk knows her name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz ðæt klɜrk noʊz hɜr neɪm/
