dialogue.zh: 她說那位店員知道她的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One town, and the same faces.
dialogue.zh: 同一座城，碰來碰去都是那幾張臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She wants it all, start to end.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɑnts ɪt ɔl stɑrt tu ɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 她想從頭聽到最後，一句都別省。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell her about the wet corner.
dialogue.zh: 跟她講講那個濕濕的角落。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, she says boxes can swim.
dialogue.zh: 講完了，她說箱子原來會游泳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Swim? That is her joke.
dialogue.zh: 游泳？那是她在開玩笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her jokes are old and warm.
dialogue.zh: 她的笑話很老，但是很暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She asked about the screws.
dialogue.zh: 她還問了螺絲那件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fourteen, and two extra ones.
dialogue.zh: 我說十四顆，另外還有多兩顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now she wants us for dinner.
dialogue.zh: 現在她想請我們過去吃飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dinner? Our kitchen is a mess.
dialogue.zh: 吃飯？我們廚房還亂成一團。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring the receipt, she said twice.
dialogue.zh: 她說要把收據帶去，講了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why a receipt at dinner?
dialogue.zh: 吃個飯為什麼要帶收據？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She wants the refund number.
dialogue.zh: 她想要那張退款的單號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She has a stuck box of her own.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi hæz ə stʌk bɑks ʌv hɜr oʊn/
dialogue.zh: 因為她自己也有個卡住的箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask her what, and where, and when.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk hɜr wʌt ænd wɛr ænd wɛn/
dialogue.zh: 問她是什麼東西、放在哪裡、何時到的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A locker in her own building.
dialogue.zh: 竟然就在她自己那棟大樓裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her own building, and she never asked?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr oʊn ˈbɪldɪŋ ænd ʃi ˈnɛvər æskt?/
dialogue.zh: 就在她那棟大樓，她卻從沒開口問？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She says the code scared her.
dialogue.zh: 她說那些數字把她嚇到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell her I can go with her.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɜr aɪ kən ɡoʊ wɪð hɜr/
dialogue.zh: 跟她說我可以陪她一起去取。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She says yes, Saturday morning.
dialogue.zh: 她說好，那就週六早上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday is free for both of us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætərˌdeɪ ɪz fri fɔr boʊθ ʌv ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 週六我們兩個都有空。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are the locker man, truly.
dialogue.zh: 你真的變成快遞櫃的高手了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Locker man, that is a job.
dialogue.zh: 快遞櫃高手，這也算一份工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A job with cold hands, still.
dialogue.zh: 而且是一份手會凍僵的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next big thing comes to my door.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst bɪɡ θɪŋ kʌmz tu maɪ dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 下次大的東西我就要送到門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pay the six dollars, wise man.
dialogue.zh: 那就花那六塊錢吧，聰明人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Home delivery, no more gates.
dialogue.zh: 送到府，再也不用摸鐵門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Unless the box holds warm soup.
dialogue.zh: 除非那盒子裝的是熱湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cabinet holds your books now.
dialogue.zh: 這個櫃子現在放著你的書了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the two shelves fit them all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə tu ʃɛlvz fɪt ðɛm ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 那兩層板把它們全都塞進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The empty box waits by the trash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɛmpti bɑks weɪts baɪ ðə træʃ/
dialogue.zh: 那個空紙箱就擱在垃圾筒旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Break it flat, the neighbor wants one.
dialogue.phonetic: /breɪk ɪt flæt ðə ˈneɪbər wɑnts wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 把它壓扁吧，鄰居也想要一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A few codes, one box, one shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə fju koʊdz wʌn bɑks wʌn ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 前後好幾組碼、一個箱子、一個架子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write that on the pink note.
dialogue.zh: 把這句話寫在那張粉紅紙條上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pink paper, by the hall light.
dialogue.zh: 粉紅色的紙，就在玄關燈的旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it off, sleep well, locker man.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ɪt ɔf slip wɛl ˈlɑkər mæn/
dialogue.zh: 把燈關了，晚安，快遞櫃先生。
